description: This file declares the MessageClient class responsible for managing message buffers, handling message instances, and interfacing with message factories within the WPEFramework's Messaging namespace. It includes methods for adding/removing instances, enabling/disabling message categories, and processing messages via callbacks.

classes.name: MessageClient
classes.description: Class responsible for managing messaging buffers, instances, and factories, enabling message processing and control within the messaging subsystem.

methods.name: MessageClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MessageClient with identifier, base path, and optional socket port.

methods.name: AddInstance
methods.description: Adds a message instance identified by an ID.

methods.name: RemoveInstance
methods.description: Removes a message instance identified by an ID.

methods.name: WaitForUpdates
methods.description: Waits for message updates for a specified duration.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a message category based on metadata.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves control information into the provided iterator.

methods.name: PopMessagesAndCall
methods.description: Processes messages and invokes the handler callback.

methods.name: AddFactory
methods.description: Adds a message event factory for a specific message type.

methods.name: RemoveFactory
methods.description: Removes a message event factory for a specific message type.
